name: @red-cup-engineering/function-movement-service
description: Deterministic function-level movement actuator: emits bounded edit artifacts for an accepted-delivery receiver.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: one exact named function, source and target package/semioverse identities, and an explicit target insertion marker
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: ambiguous function text, source/target identity collision, duplicate target insertion, or unbounded artifact scope

prepare-function-movement.returns: bounded source-removal and target-insertion artifact set for accepted-software-delivery-receiver
